extensions.name: DOM Taint Tracker
extensions.summary: Static DOM-XSS taint analysis on served HTML/JS with one-hop dataflow: connects sources (location.*, referrer, window.name, postMessage, storage) to sinks (innerHTML, eval, document.write, setTimeout, location-nav) and emits findings. The proxy-side answer to Burp DOM Invader.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: AWS SigV4 Signer
extensions.summary: Auto-signs outgoing requests to *.amazonaws.com with AWS Signature v4.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

service.desc: Override; auto-detected from host if blank

extensions.name: Identity Rotator
extensions.summary: Per-host sticky rotation of User-Agent / Accept-Language / Sec-CH-UA across realistic browser profiles.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: Taffy
extensions.summary: Inline <@tag>..<@/tag> transforms resolved on outgoing requests -- base64/url/hex/html encode+decode, sha256/sha1, upper/lower/reverse, timestamp, random, uuid, repeat. Keep payloads readable and let the tag encode on the wire; tags nest innermost-first. (Nullock's take on Hackvertor.)
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: Peep
extensions.summary: Plants OAST canaries in the headers servers tend to trust (X-Forwarded-For/Host, Referer, True-Client-IP...) so blind SSRF and out-of-band interactions ping your OAST sink. Default-OFF: a no-op until you set oastDomain. (Our Collaborator Everywhere.)
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

oastDomain.desc: Your OAST sink domain (see DEPLOY_OAST.md); BLANK disables all injection

onlyHosts.desc: Restrict injection to these hosts (exact or *.suffix); empty = every host but the OAST domain

maxPerHost.desc: Cap canary injections per host so a crawl doesn't spray thousands of tokens

extensions.name: Waltz
extensions.summary: Watches the OAuth 2.0 / OIDC dance and flags the classic missteps -- implicit flow, missing state, missing PKCE, tokens leaking into request URLs or 3xx Location headers, cleartext redirect_uri. The flow around the token that native JWT checks don't see. Observe-only.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: Sammy
extensions.summary: Pulls the base64 SAMLResponse out of an IdP auto-POST form and audits it -- unsigned assertions, XML comment-injection surface (CVE-2017-11427 class), over-long validity, missing InResponseTo/Destination, cleartext ACS. (Passive half of SAML Raider.) Observe-only.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: Mappy
extensions.summary: Flags exposed JS/CSS source maps -- external .map references, inline data: maps, or a .map served with sourcesContent (original-source leak). Where every 'unpack the bundle' recon starts. Observe-only.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: Peekaboo
extensions.summary: Peeks into ASP.NET __VIEWSTATE: decodes it and flags the unencrypted case (ObjectStateFormatter marker + readable) -- state exposed, and a deserialization/RCE surface if EnableViewStateMac is off. Encrypted ViewState is left alone. Observe-only.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: Hallpass
extensions.summary: Scans served HTML for state-changing POST forms that look like they're missing an anti-CSRF token (by field name or token-shaped hidden value). Same-origin forms only; GET ignored. Heuristic -- findings are review leads. Observe-only.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: Crumbs
extensions.summary: Picks endpoint & route crumbs out of served JavaScript -- paths, fetch()/axios() targets, route strings -- and surfaces the sensitive-looking ones (/admin, /internal, /debug, versioned APIs...) on their own. The recon map nothing links to. (LinkFinder/GAP-style.) Observe-only.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: Ouchie
extensions.summary: Catches the app saying 'ouch': framework stack traces and debug pages (Java/.NET/Python/PHP/Ruby/Node/Go), escalating exposed interactive debuggers (Werkzeug, Whoops) to high since those are usually RCE. Observe-only.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: Sniffy
extensions.summary: A nose for interesting DATA in responses (HaE-style, user-extensible): emails, SSNs, Luhn-valid card PANs, phones, private IPs/MACs, ARNs, IBANs -- redacted in findings. Add a rule to CONFIG.rules and it matches immediately. Complements native credential scanning. Observe-only.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin

extensions.name: Jelly
extensions.summary: Spots JSONP endpoints and cross-site JSON-hijacking shapes -- reflected callback wrappers (cross-site readable), arbitrary-callback reflection (XSS), and top-level JSON arrays. The callback angle native CORS checks don't cover. Observe-only.
extensions.author: nullock-builtin
